import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(SECRET_KEY='abc', DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM='sha1', SESSION_SERIALIZER='django.contrib.sessions.serializers.JSONSerializer')
django.setup()
from django.contrib.sessions.backends.db import SessionStore
s = SessionStore()
data = {'a test key': 'a test value'}
enc = s.encode(data)
print('sha1 encode:', enc[:60])
import base64
raw = base64.b64decode(enc.encode('ascii'))
print('legacy format (hash:serialized)?', b':' in raw and raw.split(b':',1)[0].decode().isalnum())
print('sha1 decode round-trip:', s.decode(enc) == data)

print('decode Django-3.0 data:', s.decode(legacy))
# and with sha256 (default) the new signing format is still used
settings.DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM = 'sha256'
enc2 = SessionStore().encode(data)
print('sha256 encode uses signing format:', enc2.count(':') >= 2)
print('sha256 decode round-trip:', SessionStore().decode(enc2) == data)
EOF
